# Community guidelines

Keep issues, pull requests and discussions respectful and relevant to SceneLight.

- Critique the work, not the person. Disagreement and bug reports are welcome.
- Do not harass, threaten, discriminate against or target other participants.
- Do not post spam or share someone's private information, artwork or game files without permission.
- Give people time to respond. Avoid repeated requests for attention.

Use GitHub's reporting tools for abusive content. For moderation help, mention
@RageAdo-dev without reposting private information or abusive material.

The maintainer may edit or remove content, lock a conversation, or block someone
for serious or repeated violations. These rules apply to everyone participating
in this repository, including the maintainer.
